user_query: I want to create a personalized voice message for my family members. Can you provide me with a list of available voices and audios? I want to choose a voice that will resonate with each family member.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of available voice options and audio samples for the voice message.
Allow the user to browse through the available voices and select preferred options for each family member.
Create a personalized voice message using the selected voices for each family member.
